item.title: Method for segmenting and denoising triangle mesh
item.description:
This patent covers a triangle-mesh processing method for segmentation and denoising. It is linked to feature-preserving surface cleanup, where the algorithm should suppress noise without washing out sharp or semantically meaningful regions.

This work appears in US Patent 12,536,620.

Algorithm principle

The method operates on triangle-mesh geometry, using segmentation cues to separate feature regions from smooth areas before denoising. That structure-aware step helps preserve surface details during smoothing.

Visual material

Detailed method and result figures are represented on the linked PAT page and related mesh-denoising publication.

Results and impact

The patent is part of the broader mesh-processing workflow used for industrial 3D data cleanup and feature-preserving denoising.

item.title: High-precision three-dimensional data real-time progressive rendering method and system
item.description:
This patent addresses real-time visualization of high-precision 3D data. Progressive rendering lets large point clouds or dense 3D measurement results become interactive before the full dataset is loaded or drawn at maximum detail.

This work appears in CN Patent WO2022257594A1(PCT).

Algorithm principle

The method organizes 3D data for progressive display, allowing coarse visual feedback first and higher-detail rendering as more data becomes available. This is useful when industrial 3D scans are too large for immediate full-resolution interaction.

Visual material

Detailed method and result figures will be added when the patent assets are available.

Results and impact

The patent supports the visualization side of industrial 3D inspection, where users need to inspect dense geometry without long waiting times.
